tasks.title: Implement pipeline plan stage with multi-round ACP
tasks.description: Implement `WorkflowController.runPlanStage()` using AcpConnection: send proposal prompt → verify → send specs prompt → verify → send design prompt → verify → send tasks prompt → verify → send self-review prompt. tasks.title: Implement pipeline core loop, gate controller, and review stage
tasks.description: Rewrite `WorkflowController` as a pipeline with `run(issue)` method executing plan → gate → build → gate → review → done. Gate controller uses `approvalState` to pause/resume. `runBuildStage()` uses RalphExecutor unchanged. `runReviewStage()` uses AcpConnection with reviewer prompt. Update `AgentRunnerService` to manage gate resume by re-invoking `Pipeline.run()` instead of resuming LLM session.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline runs stages in fixed order without LLM decision
Gates pause pipeline and wait for human approval via approvalState
Build stage uses RalphExecutor
Review stage uses AcpConnection with reviewer prompt
AgentRunnerService manages gate resume by re-invoking Pipeline.run()
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Added PipelineResult type, run() method with plan→gate→build→review→gate→done loop. runPipelineBuildStage uses RalphExecutor. runPipelineReviewStage uses AcpConnection+buildReviewerPrompt. AgentRunnerService has startPipeline/resumePipeline/hasPendingGate for pipeline gate management. Old methods preserved for backward compat.

tasks.notes: Created ExploreAcpService with run() and runOnIssue() entry points. Uses runAcpSession() with buildExplorePrompt(). Explore prompt at agents/prompts/explore.md.
